title: Sharing of Counselling Information when Primary School Students Transition to Secondary School and Beyond
what_it_is: Sharing of Counselling Information when Primary School Students Transition to Secondary School and Beyond

sections.label: Counselling support after primary school
sections.summary: School counsellors engage parents to discuss extending counselling support in the child's new school, sharing information with consent on a need-to-know basis.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Some of these students may require counselling support even after they graduate from Primary schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The school counsellors facilitate this by engaging parents to discuss how the counselling support can be extended in the child's new school.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: With the parents' consent, information such as the strategies to support the child and his challenges will be shared with the receiving school.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Such information will be managed sensitively and will only be shared on a need-to-know basis.

sections.label: Inter-agency mental health task force
sections.summary: MOE is part of the inter-agency task force for mental health and well-being, discussing continuous care that respects medical confidentiality and individuals' and parents' wishes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Member might also be aware that the inter-agency task force for mental health and well-being has been stood up.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOE is plugged into this task force and we are discussing, in great depth, on how we can provide continuous care as well as to do so in a manner that respects the need for medical confidentiality and also that respects the wishes of the individuals as well as their parents.

sections.label: Primary school mental health support numbers
sections.summary: The number of Primary school students requiring mental health support has been stable for five years, at about 16 per 1,000 students last year.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The number of students that require mental health support in our Primary school has been stable for the last five years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In particular, in the last year, the number was about 16 per 1,000 students.
